title: US ICD-10-CM map refset members as ECL ^ on the US Edition
exercises: member-of a complex map refset via ECL instead of ?fhir_vs=refset/
why: Main-expressible form of sct-implicit-refset-icd10cm-map, so the engine answer can be checked against a real tx.fhir.org expansion.

expectedDifferences.reason: tx.fhir.org returns 0 members for ^ 6011000124106 on the US Edition (its SNOMED cache does not expose this complex-map refset as a member set); our US import keeps all refsets, 138,383 members.
